Message.name: Msg2
Message.Text: You are standing in an open field west of a white house, with a boarded front door. There is a small mailbox here.

Message.name: Msg4
Message.Text: Opening the small mailbox reveals a leaflet.

Message.name: Msg6
Message.Text: (The leaflet is already inside the mailbox.)

Message.name: Msg8
Message.Text: Zork is a game of adventure, danger, and low cunning. In it you will explore some of the most amazing territory ever seen by mortals. No computer should be without one!
